Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `main` at `f28b6eb0097ff4381906d124cd6643e238d095ce`. The integration branch matches.

## Files likely to change
- `docs/INVENTORY.md`
- `changelog.d/9578-inventory-final-ci-scripts.md` (new)

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py::test_ci_runs_this_suite_and_sets_the_parity_base_only_from_the_pr_event
ACCEPTANCE: check lint
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml job tests-release-and-log-analysis

## Functions or modules to implement
No code changes. This is a documentation-inventory fix only.

1. In `docs/INVENTORY.md`, add two bullets to the Scripts section. The section is alphabetical, so they go right after line 304 (`scripts/review_freshness_ci_failed.sh`) and before line 305 (`scripts/review_head_gate.sh`). Use the existing `` - `path` — description `` format. The wording below comes from each script's header comment:
   - `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` — Sends a PR whose final CI run failed back to review/autofix: posts the head-bound `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker and dispatches the PR's review workflow (runs from the `final-ci-failed` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`). ``
   - `` - `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` — Review-sweep safety net that dispatches the final CI run, through `_pr_ensure_final_ci`, for open PRs whose head passed review but never got one (runs from `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml`). ``

   `tests/inventory_parity.py` checks every code span, so every path written in these bullets must exist. Each one was verified: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:730`, and both scripts.
2. Add a new changelog fragment, `changelog.d/9578-inventory-final-ci-scripts.md`. It starts with `<!-- changelog: fixed -->`, a category already used in `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-10-08-success-sample-reserve.md`. One bullet says that `docs/INVENTORY.md` now lists the two final-CI scripts added by #9528, which makes `main` CI's Inventory parity step pass again. Reference the issue with plain `Refs #9578` wording, not a closing keyword.
3. `tests/inventory_parity.py`, `tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` stay as they are.

## Data structures affected
None.

## API or interface changes
None. No identifiers, env vars, labels or log prefixes change.

## Decisions
### D1 — Fix the inventory instead of the parity check
- Chosen: add the two missing Scripts bullets to `docs/INVENTORY.md`.
- Alternatives considered: add the scripts to an exemption file used by `tests/inventory_parity.py`, or relax the parity rules.
- Why: the issue's fix constraints forbid weakening the failing check, and every script in the repository is supposed to be documented.

### D2 — Leave the prepush test alone
- Chosen: make no edit for the `tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py` failure.
- Alternatives considered: rewrite the assertion again.
- Why: it is already fixed on the planning ref. Lines 689-694 of the test accept both expression forms and expect the `|| env.CI_FINAL_PR_BASE_SHA` form 6 times. `ci.yml` has exactly 6 such lines (916, 926, 936, 957, 2566, 4171) and 1 PR-only line (3964), and both forms are allowed. The evidence pack shows commit 4325d9b (#9566) touching both files.

### D3 — Add a changelog fragment
- Chosen: add a short `fixed` fragment.
- Alternatives considered: no fragment, since this is a docs-only fix.
- Why: it costs a few lines and matches how other changes in this repository are recorded.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, credential or runtime path is touched. The change is Markdown only.
- The bullet text comes from repository-local script headers, not from the untrusted issue text verbatim, and carries no secrets.
- No abuse case applies: inventory entries are read only by the parity check.

## Risks and edge cases
- **Scope conflict.** This heal issue's frozen scope (`ai:workflow-heal-scope:v1 paths=.github/workflows/ci.yml,tests/**,changelog.d/*.md`) does not include `docs/INVENTORY.md`. Under the auto-decision AD-1 (Q1 = A), the existing `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope` hold in `plan.yml` is expected to stop this plan and route it to a maintainer, who applies these exact edits outside the heal pipeline. This plan includes no steps to close the issue, open other issues or PRs, or post comments.
- **Docs-only CI.** The PR is docs-only, so its final CI run may skip `tests-release-and-log-analysis` (that job has `if: ... inputs.docs_only != 'true'`, from #9566). The parity check is then certain to run only in the post-merge push CI on `main`, which is why the acceptance names that job as the post-merge check.
- **Bad code spans.** A typo in any backticked path inside the new bullets would add a new parity failure. Keep only the verified paths.
- **Concurrent PRs.** Open PRs #9510, #8307 and #9124 also edit `docs/INVENTORY.md`. Conflicts are limited to adjacent lines and are easy to resolve.

## Testing considerations
- Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/inventory_parity.py` and confirm that all five `FAIL:` lines from the evidence are gone: two "missing" lines, plus the references at `README.md:149`, `agents.md:2088` and `agents.md:2090`.
- Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py`. It should be unaffected.
- Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py::test_ci_runs_this_suite_and_sets_the_parity_base_only_from_the_pr_event`. It is expected to pass on the tip without any change.
- No new tests are needed: the existing parity script is the regression guard.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/inventory_parity.py
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for exactly two inventory bullets plus an optional changelog fragment, and auto-decision AD-1 confirms that delivery. The second failure (the prepush test assertion) is already fixed on the planning ref, so the plan neither widens nor shrinks the stated scope. Adding the changelog fragment is a few lines with no new interface, so under §6 Core Priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed) it is included. The existing parity check is the guard being satisfied; nothing new is built.

## Counterfactual check
- **`tests-release-and-log-analysis`, step "Inventory parity":** all 5 recorded failures (timestamp 10:19:05.806) say either `docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/review_final_ci_{failed,sweep}.sh` or `... but docs/INVENTORY.md does not document it`. The planned bullets document both scripts, so all five checks are satisfied. The earlier steps in that job printed `34 passed` and `12 passed`. Result: would pass.
- **`tests-system-python (6)`:** the only failure is `test_ci_runs_this_suite_and_sets_the_parity_base_only_from_the_pr_event` (`assert 1 == 6` at line 687, against the old assertion), out of `1 failed, 677 passed`. On the planning ref, that test (lines 684-696) expects 6 `|| env.CI_FINAL_PR_BASE_SHA` lines, and `ci.yml` has exactly 6 plus one allowed PR-only line. Result: would pass on the planning ref, which already includes that fix plus this change.
- **`tests-sandbox-python (codex-isolated-codex)`:** the same single assertion fails, out of `1 failed, 875 passed`. Same reasoning. Result: would pass on the planning ref.

The two pytest jobs pass because of the commit already on `main`, not because of this plan's edit. The plan's edit is what clears the remaining Inventory parity failure.

HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL: PASS

## Pre-execution self-check
- Every path in the bullet text was checked against the checkout (both scripts, `ci.yml`, and `review_autofix_sweep.yml:730`).
- `tests/inventory_parity.py` is not changed, and no check is weakened.
- The plan has no comment, close or PR-orchestration steps.
- `docs/INVENTORY.md` is outside the frozen heal scope. Per AD-1 this is expected and routes the plan to a maintainer hold. Noted here as a warning, not a blocker.
